name: Tomatoes
description: Juicy, rich and full of flavour. The base of every stew, sauce and fresh salad.

name: Peppers
description: Ata rodo, tatashe and bell peppers. Heat and colour for every pot.

name: Onions
description: Sharp purple onions from the north. Cheapest in the dry season when the trucks arrive.

name: Ugu
description: Fluted pumpkin leaves, nutritious and versatile. Perfect for soups and stews.

name: Ewedu
description: Jute leaves known for their smooth texture. A staple of Yoruba cooking.

name: Okra
description: Crisp green pods, great for soups, stews and stir fries.

name: Spinach
description: Packed with vitamins and minerals. Good for soups, stews and smoothies.

name: Carrots
description: Crisp, sweet and full of vitamins. Great for salads, stews and snacks.

name: Garden Eggs
description: Mild, tender and delicious. Great in stews and sauces or eaten fresh with groundnut.

name: Cucumber
description: Cool and crunchy. Slice it for salads or eat it on its own on a hot day.

name: Mango
description: Sweet, juicy and perfectly ripe. A true taste of Lagos sunshine.

name: Banana
description: Sweet and filling, available all year round. The easiest snack in the market.

name: Plantain
description: Green for boiling, yellow for frying. Always in the market, best from August to December.

name: Pineapple
description: Golden and fragrant. Sweetest in the middle of the year.

name: Watermelon
description: Cool, sweet and refreshing. The dry season favourite.

name: Pawpaw
description: Soft orange papaya, good for breakfast and easy on the stomach. Available all year.

name: Oranges
description: Sweet and juicy. Cheapest and best from October to February.

name: Yam
description: The king of tubers. New yam arrives in August and the markets fill up till December.

name: Sweet Corn
description: Crisp, sweet and full of goodness. Boil it or roast it by the roadside.

name: Beans
description: Honey beans and brown beans for moi moi, akara and ewa. Fresh harvest from October.

name: Sweet Potato
description: Sweet, filling and cheap. Boil, roast or fry it.

name: Scent Leaf
description: Efirin, the fragrant leaf that finishes pepper soup and jollof. Freshest in the rainy season.

name: Ginger
description: Fresh root with a warm kick. For tea, stews and marinades.

name: Fresh Eggs
description: Farm eggs sold by the crate, available all year.

name: Honey
description: Raw local honey straight from small farms. Harvested in the dry season.

name: Smoked Fish
description: Catfish and mackerel smoked the traditional way. The soul of every good soup.
